text: Zotero Research 是面向 DSH Web 的文献阅读工作台：它在侧边栏提供 Zotero 面板，并通过本地 Zotero API 读取文库，再调用 Harness 模型完成论文分层分析、原文证据核对和围绕研究问题的追问。你可以搜索论文、按页阅读、查看证据，并将整理后的笔记或标注写回 Zotero；工具接口也可供对话按需查找文献、读取论文和保存笔记。需要 Zotero Desktop 开启本地 API；写回操作需在 Zotero 中授权。分析时所选文献信息和正文片段会发给当前模型服务商。

Zotero Research adds a Zotero panel to DSH Web. It reads papers through Zotero Desktop, supports layered analysis and evidence checks, and writes notes back after authorization. Requested analysis sends selected paper details and text to the configured model provider.
我想在 DSH 里按页分析 Zotero 中的论文，并能核对结论对应的原文。
能不能把 Zotero 文献里的研究笔记整理后写回原条目？
I want to search my Zotero library and ask DSH questions about a paper’s selected pages.
Zotero Research 的功能「分层阅读与证据核对」：在面板选择论文和阅读范围后启动分析，生成分析结果并核验其中的 PDF 证据。
Zotero Research 的功能「文献笔记写回」：在取得 Zotero 写入授权后，可将编辑后的内容保存到论文条目；没有授权时写入请求会被要求先授权。
Zotero Research 使用分析时会把论文信息、所选页面正文及研究关注点发送给当前模型服务商；Zotero 授权 key 和 PDF 附件文件本身不会发送。
Selected paper details and page text go to the configured model provider; the Zotero key and PDF file do not.

dsh-zotero-research README · Zotero Research：**在 DeepSeek Harness 里读懂 Zotero 文献，把理解留在原文旁边。**

[English](README.en.md) · [安装与升级](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md) · [反馈问题](https://github.com/ZhiyingLi-Leo/dsh-zotero-research/issues) · [开发文档](CONTRIBUTING.md)

读完一篇论文，往往还需要核对结论、追问方法、对比其他工作，再把有用的内容整理成自己的笔记。Zotero Research 把这些步骤连起来：**论文 → 分层阅读 → 原文证据 → 对话追问 → 笔记与研究问题**。

包名：`dsh-zotero-research`。Zotero 负责文献与原生 PDF 阅读，Harness 承载分析和对话。

*真实阅读画面：同一篇论文的分批结果被合并，已读范围、证据数量和仍需核实的问题同时保留。*

dsh-zotero-research README · 从读完，到读懂：| 你要做的事 | 插件提供的支持 |
|---|---|
| 判断哪些论文值得读 | 搜索、主题整理、阅读队列与优先级，快速筛选研究问题和主要贡献 |
| 把论文的方法和结论读透 | 粗读、精读、分批续读与综合；整理方法、公式、图表条件、局限和复现信息 |
| 确认回答有没有依据 | 查看引用的 PDF 片段与页码，区分原文和 AI 解释，随时打开 Zotero 核对 |
| 带着问题继续推理 | 将论文、小节、证据或标注带入正式 Harness 对话，多篇文献做对比与关系分析 |
| 留下能继续使用的积累 | 将成果写回 Zotero 笔记，或归入研究问题，记录材料立场、当前理解与下一步 |
dsh-zotero-research README · 每个结论，都能回到原文：点击证据即可并排查看 PDF 片段、文字摘录与解释。这里只提供核对所需的轻量预览；需要完整阅读、原生高亮或批注时，直接打开 Zotero。
section: 每个结论，都能回到原文

dsh-zotero-research README · 让追问接上刚才读到的内容：例如：**“文中的 IoU 结果，能否直接迁移到另一种软体机器人？”**

选择要带入的文献、原文和解释，检查材料后发到新建或已有对话。讨论结果可以编辑后保存回文献，研究问题也能持续关联证据和对话。

*截图使用一篇已发表论文的实际阅读结果；对话画面展示发送前的材料确认。*

text:
dsh-zotero-research README · 安装：需要 **DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`**，以及开启本地 API 的 Zotero Desktop。

当前可下载[预构建安装包](packages/dsh-zotero-research-1.0.0-beta.3.tgz)，安装到你实际使用的 Harness profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-zotero-research-1.0.0-beta.3.tgz
```

重开 Harness 后，在侧边栏打开 **Zotero → 设置**，检查连接、模型和写入授权，再选择论文开始阅读。

npm 分发正在准备；发布后将使用 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-zotero-research@beta` 安装。完整安装、旧包升级和卸载说明见[快速开始](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md)。

dsh-zotero-research README · 平台与数据：- **macOS、Windows、Linux** 共用 PDF.js 文字提取、页数与引文定位能力。
- **PDF 图像预览**由可选的 macOS 13+ arm64 PDFKit helper 提供；其他环境使用文字证据并跳转 Zotero。
- 笔记、标注与集合写回需要 Zotero 授权。插件数据保存在本机，可导出 Markdown 与 JSON 备份；没有文库云同步。
- 模型调用会发送本次操作需要的材料，可能产生服务商费用。插件不在后台上传整个文库，也不发送 Zotero 授权密钥或 PDF 文件本身。

[中文](README.md) · [Getting started](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md#english) · [Issues](https://github.com/ZhiyingLi-Leo/dsh-zotero-research/issues) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)

dsh-zotero-research README · Zotero Research：Reading a paper is only part of the work. You still need to check its claims, question the method, compare related work, and keep notes you can use later. Zotero Research connects that workflow: **paper → layered reading → source evidence → conversation → notes and research questions**.

Package: `dsh-zotero-research`. Zotero manages the library and full PDF reading; Harness provides analysis and conversation.
dsh-zotero-research README · Zotero Research：*An actual reading session: results from multiple page ranges are combined while coverage, evidence, and unresolved questions remain visible.*

dsh-zotero-research README · From reading to understanding：| What you need | What the plugin provides |
|---|---|
| Decide what deserves attention | Search, thematic organization, a reading queue, priorities, and quick screening of questions and contributions |
| Understand methods and conclusions | Rough/deep reading, continuation across page ranges, synthesis, equations, figure conditions, limitations, and reproduction details |
| Check whether an answer has evidence | PDF excerpts and page references, separate source text and AI explanations, and opening the paper in Zotero |
| Follow a question further | Bring papers, sections, evidence, or annotations into real Harness conversations; compare papers and explore their relationships |
| Keep useful research progress | Save edited results to Zotero notes, or collect evidence, stances, understanding, and next steps around a research question |

dsh-zotero-research README · Follow a claim back to its source：Open an evidence card to compare the PDF excerpt, extracted quotation, and explanation. The preview is for checking a passage. Open Zotero for full reading and native highlights or comments.
section: Follow a claim back to its source

text:
dsh-zotero-research README · Continue the conversation with the right context：For example: **“Does this IoU result mean the method can transfer directly to another soft robot?”**

Choose the paper, quotation, and explanation to include, review the materials, then send them to a new or existing conversation. Edit and save useful results back to the paper, and connect evidence and conversations to an ongoing research question.

*Screenshots show a real reading session with a published paper. The conversation view shows the materials before sending.*
section: Continue the conversation with the right context

text:
dsh-zotero-research README · Install：Requires **DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`** and Zotero Desktop with its local API enabled.

Download the [prebuilt package](packages/dsh-zotero-research-1.0.0-beta.3.tgz) and install it into the Harness profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-zotero-research-1.0.0-beta.3.tgz
```

Restart Harness, open **Zotero → Settings**, check the connection, model, and write authorization, then select a paper.

dsh-zotero-research README · Install：npm distribution is being prepared. After publication, the command will be `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-zotero-research@beta`. See [Getting started](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md#english) for installation, upgrading from the old package, and removal.

dsh-zotero-research README · Platforms and data：- **macOS, Windows, and Linux** share PDF.js text extraction, page counting, and quote location.
- **PDF image preview** uses the optional macOS 13+ arm64 PDFKit helper. Other environments retain text evidence and Zotero opening.
- Writing notes, annotations, or collections requires Zotero authorization. Plugin records stay local and can be exported as Markdown or backed up as JSON; there is no cloud library sync.
- Model calls send the materials needed for the requested operation and may incur provider charges. The plugin does not upload the whole library in the background or send the Zotero authorization key or PDF file itself.
